notes: Related ECR brands listed on the page (Argo, Dunkirk, ECR, EMI, E-verter, Olsen, Oneida Royal, Pennco, RetroAire, Ultimate, Utica) are not stated to share this serial system, so no sister is claimed. Style 1 ships year-only: its year digits are text-stated, but its month is a 5th-position letter under a chart that exists only as an image (Style-1_Airco_Date-of-Manufacture_Serial-Number-Nomenclature.png) and is not guessed. Style 2 is HELD entirely: both its month (1st character) and year (2nd character) are chart letters with no text table (images Style-2_Airco_Date-of-Manufacture_Serial-Number-Nomenclature.png and ECR-Brands-and-Serial-Number-Styles.png).

styles.notes: Page positions 3-4 = year; 5th character = month letter (chart image only, held). Page example shown as 1207 A012064.
